_note: SYNTHETIC worked example. Address, parcel, comps, and coordinates are fabricated (pins shifted 0.10 deg west into Mobile Bay on purpose). Numbers come from a real Fairhope-area run and every one recomputes from its own inputs. One house across all three skills, so every dashboard cross-check fires.

title.tagline: A buyer's diligence brief on a 1992 five-bedroom on 0.71 acres, 0.6 mi from Fairhope East Elementary. Vacant, sold as-is, listed cash or conventional only. The all-in monthly cost, what it is worth, and a script for the negotiation. SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE: address, parcel, MLS, and comps are fabricated.

exec_summary.headline: The Good. The Bad. The Ugly.
good: 3,135 sq ft (public record), 5 bed / 3 full bath, 0.71 acre, no HOA. Most space per dollar in its price band.
Assigned schools all rate 10/10 on GreatSchools: Fairhope East Elementary (0.6 mi), Fairhope Middle, Fairhope High.
Roof 5 yrs, both HVAC systems 2 yrs, full replumb, appliances 5 yrs, upgraded primary bath (you confirmed).
Outside the flood zone, on city sewer, inside Fairhope city limits (you confirmed). First Street flood and fire both 1/10.
Built 1992: no federal lead-paint disclosure; replumb claim, if true, closes the polybutylene question.
Vacant: sellers moved out, so carrying costs sit on them while it is listed.
bad: Listed at $539K. The appraisal sibling puts value at $452K (range $420K-$484K). List is 19% above the point.
Sold as-is. Listing accepts cash or conventional only, which conflicts with an FHA plan.
Maintenance is done; upgrades are not. Before move-in: front door and frame, 3 panes, carpet, porch boards, fence, siding, rot at the garage wall base.
Kitchen has 5-yr appliances but no finish upgrades. No permits in hand yet for the roof, HVAC, or replumb.
Public record says 3,135 sq ft; the listing says 3,200.
ugly: First Street wind factor 9/10, about 2.4 mi from Mobile Bay. Insurance est. $5,000-$9,500/yr is the widest swing in carry.
At 7.40% PMMS, all-in carry at $475K with FHA is about $4,221/mo before maintenance.
Tax grew 10.1%/yr from 2020 to 2025 on this parcel. Carry rises about $271/mo by year 5.
Seller paid $185,000 in Sept 2017. Asking is 2.9x that, so expect them to anchor on equity, not comps.
City-limits taxes: 46.0 mills total, so the post-sale reset hits harder than a county address would.

price_history.title: Bought for $185K in 2017, Asking $539K Today
price_history.subtitle: Public sale record since 2001, then this listing. No reductions yet and 12 days on market against a 73-day area average to pending. The seller's leverage comes from equity, not from a hot market.
price_history.source_note: Sources: Redfin price history (MLS; public records). 2013 shows MLS $195,000 and recorded $195,250 a week apart; the recorded figure is used.

comps.title: What the Subject Should Cost
comps.subtitle: Five recorded 2025-26 sales within 2.5 mi, all 2,894-3,298 sq ft. They are 11-21 years newer than the subject, so the screen strips a newer-build premium, then applies a cosmetic discount for the walkthrough repair list. This is a screen; the appraisal deck carries the value.
comps.implied_takeaway: Screen: $439K-$489K at 3,135 sq ft. The appraisal's $452K point sits inside it (3% below the screen midpoint). List at $539K is $50K above the screen's top.
comps.source_note: All five are recorded closed sales from Redfin sold pages (MLS). No AVM is used as a comp. Average: (164+152+175+183+157)/5 = 166. Strips compound: 166 x 0.94 = 156; 156 x 0.90 = 140.

projection.title: What This Property Costs Over Time
projection.subtitle: This parcel's tax rose 10.1%/yr from 2020 to 2025, above the 6% default, so the parcel rate is used. Insurance grows 7%/yr. P&I is the FHA case, held fixed.
projection.cumulative_note: Cumulative 5-yr extra cost over a flat baseline: $7,824 (sum of the four year-over-year deltas x 12). Excludes FHA MIP.
projection.source_note: Assumes 10% annual tax growth (parcel trailing 2020-2025: $1,242 to $2,009) and 7% insurance growth. P&I fixed at 7.40% on the FHA loan.

schools.title: School Assignments
schools.subtitle: All three assigned schools rate 10/10 on GreatSchools. This is the resale floor. Fairhope is studying a city-run system separate from Baldwin County; watch that, since it could change taxes and assignments.
schools.source_note: Sources: GreatSchools via Redfin; Niche K-12; NBC15 reporting on the Fairhope city-schools study. Confirm zoning with Baldwin County Public Schools.

climate.title: Climate & Hazard Exposure
climate.subtitle: Wind and heat are the real exposures; flood and fire score minimal. Wind drives what insurance costs here. The insurance brief carries the sourced premium range and quote spec.

risks.label: WIND / HURRICANE
risks.body: First Street Wind Factor 9/10: 99% chance of strong winds in 30 years. About 2.4 mi from Mobile Bay. Expect a 2% named-storm deductible ($10,000 on a $500K Cov A).

risks.label: HEAT
risks.body: First Street Heat Factor 10/10. Two new HVAC systems matter here; verify serials and sizing at inspection.

risks.label: FLOOD
risks.body: Outside the FEMA flood zone (you confirmed); First Street Flood Factor 1/10. Flood is not lender-required. The lender's flood cert will confirm.

risks.label: WILDFIRE
risks.body: First Street Fire Factor 1/10. Non-issue for diligence.

risks.label: AIR QUALITY
risks.body: First Street Air Factor 4/10: about 4 unhealthy air days this year.

risks.label: BUILD ERA (1992)
risks.body: Post-1978, so no lead-paint disclosure. 1978-96 is the polybutylene window; the listing claims a full replumb. Confirm no poly-B remains at the water heater.

climate.source_note: Sources: First Street Foundation factors via Redfin; flood zone status per buyer. Earthquake and radon are not material here and are omitted.

red_flags.title: What to Resolve Before You Sign

items.title: List is 19% above value
items.body: Appraisal point $452K, range $420K-$484K, Medium confidence. List $539K. Anchor on the comp grid, not the seller's 2017 basis.

items.title: Cash or conventional only
items.body: Your plan is FHA. FHA appraisers flag rotted siding, porch, and trim as minimum-property-standard items. Ask whether FHA 203(k) Limited is acceptable before writing.

items.title: Repairs before move-in
items.body: Front door and frame, 3 panes, carpet, porch boards, fence, siding, and rot at the garage wall base. Est. $15K before move-in; the rot needs a sill-plate and termite probe.

items.title: Permits not in hand
items.body: Roof (5 yrs), both HVAC systems (2 yrs), and the replumb are confirmed but unpermitted on paper so far. Carriers and appraisers want the City of Fairhope records.

items.title: Insurance is the big swing
items.body: Wind Factor 9/10, ~2.4 mi from the bay. Est. $5,000-$9,500/yr. Bind a real quote before the inspection contingency ends.

items.title: Square footage gap
items.body: Public record says 3,135 sq ft; the listing says 3,200. Value and insurance here use 3,135. Ask where the extra 65 sq ft comes from.

red_flags.footer_note: These are the items that change the number. Nothing here substitutes for the inspection.

scripts.title: Bring These Into the Negotiation
scripts.subtitle: Three audiences, three lists. Every question ties to something in the listing, the record, or your walkthrough.
agent: Cash or conventional only: is that the seller's rule or a default? Would they take FHA 203(k) Limited with repairs financed?
The roof is 5 years old. Who installed it, is it permitted, and is there a FORTIFIED certificate?
Both HVAC systems are 2 years old and the house was replumbed. Permits and receipts?
Appliances are 5 years old. Any warranties that transfer?
Any sewer backups or line repairs since 2017? Where is the cleanout?
Public record shows 3,135 sq ft; the listing says 3,200. Where is the difference?
Since the Sept 2017 purchase at $185,000, what work was done, with receipts?
Any insurance claims since 2017, including Hurricane Sally in 2020? Will they share the CLUE report?
The sellers have moved out. What is their timeline, and would they take a repair credit over repairs?
neighbors: How busy is Example Pecan Rd at school drop-off and pickup?
What did Hurricane Sally do on this stretch in 2020?
Does water stand anywhere after a heavy rain?
Any sewer backups or main repairs on this stretch?
How long has 9055 been empty? Any issues while vacant?
Any building or road projects planned nearby?
inspector: Garage wall base: probe bottom plate and sheathing for rot depth.
Siding and 540 sq ft porch: rot extent in boards, joists, and ledger.
Windows: 3 failed Andersen panes noted; check the rest for seal failure.
Roof: confirm age, deck nailing, and secondary water barrier for FORTIFIED.
HVAC: confirm both systems' 2-yr serials and sizing for two stories.
Plumbing: confirm the full replumb; no poly-B at water heater or main.
Electrical: 1992 panel brand, capacity, and any double taps.
Termite: active activity or damage in porch, trim, or door frames.
scripts.footer_note: Print this slide. The questions you don't ask in writing are the issues you find at closing.

phases.title: PRE-OFFER
items: Ask the listing agent whether the seller will accept FHA 203(k) Limited.
Pull roof, HVAC, and plumbing permits from the City of Fairhope.
Ask for receipts on the HVAC and replumb.
Get one insurance quote on the attached spec sheet.

phases.title: AT OFFER
items: Offer with the repair list attached as the basis for price.
Ask for seller-paid closing costs; keep the 10-14 day inspection window.
Request the Alabama disclosure and the CLUE report.
Line up two contractor bids for the 203(k) repair scope.

phases.title: INSPECTION
items: General inspection with moisture readings on siding and trim.
Sewer scope of the lateral to the city main.
FORTIFIED roof evaluation if the roof is under 10 years.

phases.title: PRE-CLOSING
items: Bind insurance on the spec; confirm wind deductible in dollars.
Confirm the 203(k) repair escrow and contractor schedule.
File homestead with the Revenue Commission after closing.
Final walkthrough of the vacant house day-of-closing.

offer.title: The Number, The Walk-Away, The Upside
rationale_lines: Appraisal point $452K sits inside that band.
walk_away: Garage-wall rot runs into the sill plate or framing.
Seller refuses FHA and conventional terms do not work for you.
Bound insurance quote lands above $9,500/yr on the spec.
Price ends above $484K, the top of the appraisal range.
reduce_further: Roof or HVAC is older than claimed, or unpermitted.
Sewer scope finds a cracked or root-bound lateral.
Window seal failures beyond the 3 panes you saw.
Termite damage in porch, trim, or door frames.
go_to_ask: Roof, HVAC, and plumbing permits all in hand.
Seller accepts FHA 203(k) and pays closing costs.
Inspection confirms the repair list is cosmetic only.
A competing offer is verified, not just claimed.
offer.bottom_line: Worth about $452K, not $539K. Systems are done; finishes are not. Pay for the space and schools, not the seller's 2017 equity.
